title: Which Reset Would Tell?
status: finite diagnostic-access audit; not a live-model experiment
lineage: The Shape That Remains, Suite C, v0.1.0
question: Which allowed source interventions distinguish otherwise identical dynamical mechanisms?
intervention_semantics: Clone the original carrier tuple separately for every query; clear only the named carrier; reset dynamic x to zero; apply one probe; observe sign with thresholds +/-3. Clearing one component cannot silently clear another.
known_prior_control: Repeat partitions with common prior fixed at zero (27 hypotheses).
contrasts: acquired-versus-prior alias under inaccessible learned-state interventions
limitations: Complete candidate family is stipulated, not inferred from a commercial system.
Reset, source removal, and matched branching are assumed perfectly available.
Learned carrier is assigned, not acquired by training here.
No stochastic noise, wall-clock or API-cost model.
The intervention ranking depends on this additive mechanism and is not a minimal-query or general memory-detection guarantee.
design_status: Frozen after reading parent results and deriving expected algebraic counts; before new enumeration. Same-author design, not blind discovery or external preregistration.
